results.title: Graph neural networks in histopathology: Emerging trends and future directions - ScienceDirect
results.content: # Graph neural networks in histopathology: Emerging trends and future directions. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are increasingly used in histopathology. However, CNNs often fail to capture the intricate spatial dependencies inherent in WSIs. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) present a promising alternative, adept at directly modeling pairwise interactions and effectively discerning the topological tissue and cellular structures within WSIs. Recognizing the pressing need for deep learning techniques that harness the topological structure of WSIs, the application of GNNs in histopathology has experienced rapid growth. In this comprehensive review, we survey GNNs in histopathology, discuss their applications, and explore emerging trends that pave the way for future advancements in the field. Leveraging quantitative literature analysis, we explore four emerging trends: *Hierarchical GNNs*, *Adaptive Graph Structure Learning*, *Multimodal GNNs*, and *Higher-order GNNs*. Through an in-depth exploration of these trends, we offer insights into the evolving landscape of GNNs in histopathological analysis.
